name: Paystack payments
manualSteps: Create initialize and webhook route files using the exported route factories.
Resolve the payable order and amount from server-side data, never the browser.
Implement idempotent fulfillment before enabling a live webhook.
Mount the initialize handler behind application authentication and resolve the order, amount, currency, and reference from trusted server-side state.
Mount paystackWebhookBody before express.json() for the webhook path so signature verification receives the raw body.
